1 3:22 How much comedy skill is needed to use humour in a sales context??Very little. Studies show that adding even a simple lighthearted line to a sales pitch — like "I'll throw in my pet frog" — makes people willing to pay nearly 20% more. The bar is very low.
2 3:42 How does laughter influence our relationships??Laughter shortens the path to connection. When people share a laugh, they tend to disclose more personal information, which builds trust and strengthens the relationship.
3 4:15 What happens in our brain when we laugh??Laughing releases endorphins, dopamine, and oxytocin while lowering cortisol. The speakers compare it to exercising, meditating, and having sex at the same time.
